title: Rirkrit Tiravanija
subtitle: In Aliens We Trust
body: For In Aliens We Trust, Rirkrit Tiravanija transforms the galleries into a space of gathering, cooking, and conversation. Extending his long-running inquiry into hospitality as a medium, the exhibition invites visitors to participate rather than observe — sharing meals, reading rooms, and printed slogans that blur the line between artwork, social space, and everyday life.
